user.title: Add a sourdough starter
user.description: Track when this starter was fed and when it is due again.

data_description.last_fed: Optional. Leave empty if the starter has not been fed yet.
data_description.bench_interval_hours: Hours between feeds while stored on the bench. Default: 48.
data_description.fridge_interval_hours: Hours between feeds while refrigerated. Default: 168.
data_description.due_soon_hours: How many hours before the deadline the first reminder is sent. Use 0 to disable the early reminder.
data_description.notification_targets: Choose one or more notification entities. Overdue reminders repeat every 30 minutes until a feed is recorded.
